info.name: Real Estate Public API
info.description:
Public REST endpoints for the ATMTA real-estate suite plus iframe-embeddable 2D drill plan and 3D maquette.

Dev server: http://egyptairodoodev.isdeg.com:8069

Setup
-----
1. `{{base_url}}` is pre-set to the dev host above. Change for prod when ready.
2. Set `{{db_name}}` to the target Odoo database on that host — ask the team if you don't know it.
3. Set `{{api_key}}` to an API key (scope `real_estate_api`) issued for your integration.
4. Set `{{website_origin}}` to the origin your iframe will load from. Must be in the server's `real_estate_api.cors.allowed_origins` and in each embed token's `allowed_origins`.
5. Run requests top-to-bottom. The first call (`Catalog / List Projects`) fills `{{first_project_id}}` so deeper requests work out of the box. Adjust `{{project_with_2d}}` and `{{project_with_3d}}` to a project that has those assets configured.

Wire format
-----------
* `X-Odoo-Database: {{db_name}}` is injected on every request by a collection-level pre-request script. Do NOT send a `session_id` cookie alongside it — the server returns 403 on collision.
* Catalog GETs are public — the API key is optional. Mutating calls (`Embed Tokens`, `Interests`) require `Authorization: Bearer {{api_key}}`.
* Errors come back as `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}` with the correct HTTP status. No silent fallbacks — 404 on missing record, 400 on bad input, 403 on origin mismatch, 429 when rate-limited.

Base URL: {{base_url}}
